skill.description: Routes image-to-video requests to the right RunComfy model for still-image animation, custom-audio lip-sync, or multimodal image, video, and audio generation.
skill.summary: Route still images to RunComfy models for animation, lip-sync, and multimodal video generation.

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are Markdown formatting, placeholder media URLs, or public RunComfy links. The remaining confirmed risks are intended use of external CLI commands and persistent RunComfy token storage, with no evidence of prompt injection or covert exfiltration in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution is required for the skill workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Make command execution and RunComfy credit usage explicit before running the CLI, especially in automated agents.

remediation.issue: RunComfy authentication stores an API token in a hidden user configuration path.
remediation.suggestion: Document token revocation and recommend RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for ephemeral CI or container runs.

remediation.issue: Example commands write generated outputs to a user-selected directory.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a dedicated output directory and avoid writing generated media into sensitive project paths.

content.value_statement: Choosing the right image-to-video model can waste time and credits. This skill routes each request to RunComfy models for animation, lip-sync, or multimodal video.
actual_capabilities: Classifies requests for HappyHorse 1.0 I2V, Wan 2.7, or Seedance 2.0 Pro.
Provides RunComfy CLI invocation guidance for each supported route.
Supports still-image animation with prompt, duration, resolution, seed, and watermark guidance.
Supports custom voiceover lip-sync through Wan 2.7 audio_url inputs.
Supports multimodal references through Seedance image_url, video_url, and audio_url arrays.
Documents model limits, output directory behavior, exit codes, and token storage.
limitations: Requires a RunComfy account, RunComfy CLI access, and hosted source media URLs.
Uses external RunComfy services and does not render videos offline.
Runs one model route per request and does not stitch outputs across routes.
Duration, resolution, aspect ratio, and file size limits depend on the selected model.

use_cases.title: Animate Product Stills
use_cases.description: Create short reveal clips, camera moves, or macro motion from a product image while preserving shape and packaging.

use_cases.title: Create Voiceover Shorts
use_cases.description: Generate talking-head clips that follow a supplied audio track for social posts or localized campaign variants.

use_cases.title: Combine Reference Media
use_cases.description: Use image, video, and audio references to guide a single short scene with stable subjects and consistent tone.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Still Animation
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple motion clip.
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate this image with a slow camera drift, subtle subject motion, stable identity, and natural light. Use the default RunComfy route.

prompt_templates.title: Product Reveal Clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a controlled product animation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this product image into a short reveal video. Preserve packaging text, keep geometry stable, and use one smooth orbit motion.

prompt_templates.title: Custom Voice Lip-Sync
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with a hosted voiceover track.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a vertical spokesperson video using this audio URL. Match the duration to the audio and avoid subtitles, flicker, and distorted hands.

prompt_templates.title: Multimodal Reference Scene
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request combining image, video, and audio references.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use image 1 for the subject, video 1 for scene motion, and audio 1 for voice tone. Create an eight-second warm close-up.

output_examples.input: A portrait image needs a short animated clip with natural movement.
output_examples.output: The skill selects HappyHorse 1.0 I2V and prepares a prompt focused on breathing, blinking, camera drift, and identity preservation.

output_examples.input: A brand has one image and separate audio files for several languages.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Wan 2.7 with audio_url and recommends reusing the visual prompt while swapping each voiceover URL.

output_examples.input: A campaign clip should match a subject photo, a scene video, and a voice sample.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Seedance 2.0 Pro and maps the subject, scene, and voice references into one multimodal generation request.

best_practices: Lead prompts with one clear motion, camera move, or subject action.
Use hosted media URLs that meet the selected model file size and duration limits.
Lock seeds when comparing variants or creating multi-language versions.
anti_patterns: Do not ask one call to combine multiple model routes or stitch separate clips.
Do not over-describe static image details that the model can already see.
Do not mix reference media with conflicting styles unless drift is acceptable.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It routes image-to-video requests to RunComfy models for animation, lip-sync, or multimodal video generation.

faq.question: Does it require RunComfy?
faq.answer: Yes. It expects the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and access to supported hosted media URLs.

faq.question: Which model is used by default?
faq.answer: The skill defaults to HappyHorse 1.0 I2V for general still-image animation when no special requirement is given.

faq.question: Can it use a custom voiceover?
faq.answer: Yes. It routes custom voiceover lip-sync requests to Wan 2.7 with an audio_url input.

faq.question: Can it combine image, video, and audio references?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses Seedance 2.0 Pro when the request needs image, video, and audio references together.

faq.question: Does it create long videos?
faq.answer: No. The documented routes are for short clips, with model-specific limits up to about fifteen seconds.
